commands.review_summary:
The PR adds cancellation checks around maximize-frame settling reads and sleeps, adds two regression tests, and adds a changelog credit.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: current main suppresses the polling sleep's cancellation error and can continue reading, and the focused production-helper tests exercise both cancellation boundaries. A real command-level failing run was not independently reproduced.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Contributor-supplied real cancellation proof remains a merge gate that automation cannot manufacture; after proof is added, a maintainer should refresh review and ensure the changelog line is removed.

target.title: fix(window): honor task cancellation while settling maximize frame
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`settleWindowFrame`, used after `window maximize`, suppressed `CancellationError` from its polling sleep. A cancelled command could therefore consume the remaining accessibility-read budget instead of stopping promptly.

## Changes

- Check cancellation before the first read, around every sleep, and after every asynchronous read.
- Preserve the helper's nonthrowing `stabilized: false` contract so the command executor remains responsible for surfacing cancellation and discarding buffered success output.
- Add deterministic production-helper regressions for pre-cancellation and cancellation during sleep.
- Remove the standalone model script; the real helper is now exercised directly.
- Add maintainer changelog credit for @SebTardif.

## Verification

- `swift test --package-path Apps/CLI --filter WindowMaximizeSettleTests -Xswiftc -DPEEKABOO_SKIP_AUTOMATION` — 14 tests passed.
- `pnpm run test:safe` — 746 tests / 85 suites passed.
- `pnpm run lint` — exit 0; 13 pre-existing warnings, 0 serious.
- `pnpm run format` — clean; 0 files changed.
- Branch CLI against a controlled TextEdit window: `window set-bounds` reached `(220, 180, 720, 520)` exactly; `window maximize` succeeded through a permissioned signed host and reported the final `1944 × 1274` frame.
- Autoreview of the maintainer cleanup: clean, 0 findings, confidence 0.97.
- Autoreview of the full rebased PR branch: clean, 0 findings, confidence 0.96.

Hosted CI must pass on exact head before merge.
